faculty.name: Leo Alexander III
faculty.summary: Studies personnel selection, adverse impact, and psychometrics, focusing on machine learning in employee hiring and recruitment.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人员选拔、不利影响和心理测量学，重点关注机器学习在员工招聘和招聘中的应用。

faculty.name: Diane M Beck
faculty.summary: Studies how visual perception and attention work together to process and represent the world, using neuroimaging and behavioral methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和注意力如何共同作用来处理和表征世界，使用神经成像和行为方法。

faculty.name: Aaron S Benjamin
faculty.summary: Studies how human learning, memory, and decision-making processes interact, using various experimental methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类学习、记忆和决策过程的相互作用，使用多种实验方法。

faculty.name: D. A. Briley
faculty.summary: Studies how individual differences and socioecological contexts influence personality and identity development, with a focus on gender.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究个体差异和社会生态因素如何影响人格和身份发展，特别关注性别。

faculty.name: Víctor H Cervantes
faculty.summary: Studies the foundations of probability and probabilistic contextuality across sciences, using mathematical and computational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究概率和概率上下文性在科学中的基础，使用数学和计算方法。

faculty.name: Amy Cohen
faculty.summary: Trains doctoral student clinicians in assessing developmental disabilities and leads the University of Illinois Autism Clinic.
faculty.summary_zh: 培训博士生临床医生评估发育障碍，并领导伊利诺伊州立大学自闭症诊所。

faculty.name: Dov Cohen
faculty.summary: Studies social psychology, focusing on dignity, honor, and face cultures, and their impact on mental health and behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会心理学，重点关注尊严、荣誉和面子文化对心理健康和行为的影响。

faculty.name: Joseph Rich Cohen
faculty.summary: Studies the development of internalizing symptoms in children and adolescents, focusing on cognitive, interpersonal, and physiological factors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童和青少年内部化症状的发展，重点关注认知、人际和生理因素。

faculty.name: Jaime Lane Derringer
faculty.summary: Studies individual differences in behavior using genetic methods and psychological assessment, focusing on gender and sexuality.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用遗传方法和心理评估研究行为的个体差异，重点关注性别和性取向。

faculty.name: Florin Dolcos
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of emotion-cognition interactions in healthy and clinical populations using fMRI and ERP.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪与认知交互的神经机制，在健康和临床人群中的应用，使用fMRI和ERP技术。

faculty.name: Monica Fabiani
faculty.summary: Studies aging and cognitive control using ERPs, MRI, and NIRS, focusing on individual differences and neurovascular coupling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知控制和老化，使用ERPs、MRI和NIRS，关注个体差异和神经血管耦合。

faculty.name: Catharine Edith Ann Fairbairn
faculty.summary: Studies the impact of social and emotional processes on substance use, integrating machine learning and biosensors for addiction interventions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会和情绪过程对物质使用的影响，结合机器学习和生物传感器进行成瘾干预。

faculty.name: Kara D Federmeier
faculty.summary: Studies how semantic information is organized and accessed during language comprehension in younger and older adults, using electrophysiological techniques and behavioral methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言理解过程中语义信息的组织和调用方式，使用电生理技术及行为方法探讨不同年龄段的认知过程。

faculty.name: Cynthia L Fisher
faculty.summary: Studies how children use linguistic structures to understand verb meanings and the special properties of speech addressed to young children.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童如何利用语言结构理解动词意义以及针对幼儿的特殊语音特征。

faculty.name: R. Chris Fraley
faculty.summary: Studies attachment processes in close relationships, personality dynamics and development, with a focus on why some people are more secure than others in their relationships and how attachment.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究亲密关系中的依恋过程、个性动态和发展，重点在于为什么有些人比其他人更安全地维持关系以及依恋模式如何随时间变化。

faculty.name: Lynda Gibson
faculty.summary: Studies the impact of childhood trauma and community violence on African American and Latinx communities, focusing on early intervention and trauma-informed schools.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究童年创伤和社区暴力对非洲裔美国人和拉丁美洲社区的影响，重点关注早期干预和创伤知情学校。

faculty.name: Jozien Goense
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural basis, focusing on attention and memory.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注注意力和工作记忆。

faculty.name: Caterina Gratton
faculty.summary: Studies the organization and function of human brain networks and how they contribute to goal-directed cognition, using fMRI and patient recordings.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类大脑网络的组织和功能及其如何贡献于目标导向的认知，采用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和患者记录的方法。

faculty.name: Benjamin L Hankin
faculty.summary: Studies risk factors and mechanisms in depression and related disorders in children and adolescents, using longitudinal designs and translational approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童和青少年抑郁及相关障碍的风险因素和机制，使用纵向设计和转化方法。

faculty.name: Wendy Heller
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of emotion-cognition interactions, particularly in anxiety and depression, using fMRI, EEG, and ERP methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪与认知交互的神经机制，特别是焦虑和抑郁，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、脑电图（EEG）和事件相关电位（ERP）方法。

faculty.name: James R Hinman
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain represents space and navigates the world using electrophysiology and calcium imaging in rats.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何表示空间以及如何导航世界，使用电生理学和钙成像技术在自由活动的鼠类中进行记录/成像。

faculty.name: LaTasha R. Holden
faculty.summary: Studies working memory, long-term memory, and learning, focusing on individual differences and culturally responsive pedagogy.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究工作记忆、长时记忆和学习，关注个体差异和文化响应型教学法。

faculty.name: Jared Hotaling
faculty.summary: Studies how people make decisions in complex scenarios, using cognitive models and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究复杂情境下的人类决策过程，采用认知建模和行为实验的方法。

faculty.name: John E Hummel
faculty.summary: Studies how neural architectures represent and process relational structures in perception and reasoning, using computational models and experiments with human subjects.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经架构如何表示和处理知觉和推理中的关系结构，使用计算模型和人类被试的实验方法。

faculty.name: Carla Desi-Ann Hunter
faculty.summary: Studies identity and well-being in African Americans and British Caribbean Americans, exploring the impact of racial identity and discrimination on mental health.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究非洲裔美国人和英属加勒比裔美国人的身份和福祉，探讨种族身份和歧视对其心理健康的影响。

faculty.name: Daniel Hyde
faculty.summary: Studies the development of abstract concepts, numerical reasoning, and social cognition in infants and children using EEG, fNIRS, and behavioral measures.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿和儿童的抽象概念、数理推理和社会认知的发展，使用EEG、fNIRS和行为测量方法。

faculty.name: Caroline Kelsey
faculty.summary: Studies how infants and young children develop, focusing on brain changes and early experiences using behavioral and neuroimaging methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿和幼儿的发展，重点关注大脑变化和早期经历，使用行为和神经成像方法。

faculty.name: Hans Friedrich Koehn
faculty.summary: Develops machine learning and cognitive diagnosis models, particularly focusing on Q-matrix theory and clustering methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发机器学习和认知诊断模型，特别是Q矩阵理论和聚类方法。

faculty.name: Benedek Kurdi
faculty.summary: Studies how humans adaptively respond to new information and how learning is modulated by social environment constraints.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类如何适应性地应对新信息以及学习如何受到更广泛社会环境约束的影响。

faculty.name: Nu-Chu Liang
faculty.summary: Studies ingestive behaviors and their relation to obesity, drug dependence, and cognitive decline, using animal models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究摄食行为及其与肥胖、药物依赖和认知衰退的关系，使用动物模型。

faculty.name: Alejandro Lleras
faculty.summary: Studies attention and visual perception, focusing on how attention works and fails, and how objects are found in scenes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究注意力和视觉感知，关注注意力的工作机制及其失败，以及如何在场景中找到物体。

faculty.name: Kimberly Long
faculty.summary: Studies the neural and neuroendocrine mechanisms of social attachment using prairie voles, combining neural recordings, molecular genetics, and behavioral analyses.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会依附的神经和神经内分泌机制，使用原野鼠作为模型，结合神经记录、分子遗传学和行为分析方法。

faculty.name: Steve Maren
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiology of fear and anxiety, focusing on the contextual regulation of memory and the impact of stress on fear extinction.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究恐惧和焦虑的神经生物学，重点关注记忆的上下文调节和压力对恐惧消退的影响。

faculty.name: Haylee Min
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and their development in children, using behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童认知过程的发展，使用行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Dominik Mischkowski
faculty.summary: Studies how physical pain affects emotions and social behavior, using methods like pharmacological interventions and physiological measures.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究物理疼痛如何调节情绪和社会行为，使用药理干预和生理测量等方法。

faculty.name: Jessica L Montag
faculty.summary: Studies how language abilities develop with experience across the lifespan, using experiments and corpus analyses.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言能力随经验在一生中的发展，使用实验和语料库分析方法。

faculty.name: Daniel A Newman
faculty.summary: Studies diversity in HR management, leadership, and social networks, using research methods and network contagion models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人力资源管理中的多样性、领导力和社会网络，使用研究方法和网络传染模型。

faculty.name: Eva Marie Pomerantz
faculty.summary: Studies how parents can support children's math learning and achievement, focusing on cultural contexts in the U.S. and China.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究如何通过父母支持促进儿童数学学习和成就，重点关注美国和中国的文化背景。

faculty.name: Michel Regenwetter
faculty.summary: Models and predicts preference and choice behavior, using probabilistic measurement, social choice, and preference evolution over time.
faculty.summary_zh: 建模和预测偏好和选择行为，使用概率测量、社会选择和随时间变化的偏好。

faculty.name: Justin S Rhodes
faculty.summary: Studies the genetic and physiological bases of natural motivation and exercise, using mice and brain imaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自然动机和运动的遗传和生理基础，使用小鼠和脑成像技术。

faculty.name: Kimberly Michelle Rios
faculty.summary: Studies how majority and minority group members perceive and respond to threats to their social and personal identities, focusing on multiculturalism and religious stereotypes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究多数群体和少数群体成员如何感知和应对对其社会和个人身份的威胁，重点关注多元文化主义和宗教刻板印象。

faculty.name: Michael T. Rizzo
faculty.summary: Studies how children develop conceptions of fairness and social biases, using constructivist methods to examine the role of experiences and interpretations in shaping these processes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童公平观念和社会偏见的发展，采用建构主义方法探讨经验和解释在这些过程中的作用。

faculty.name: Brent W Roberts
faculty.summary: Studies personality development and change across adulthood, focusing on conscientiousness and narcissism, and how personality can be changed through intervention.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究成年期人格的发展与变化，重点关注自律性和自恋性，并探讨通过干预如何改变人格。

faculty.name: Violeta Rodriguez Palacios
faculty.summary: Studies health equity, parenting, family dynamics, and psychometrics to improve mental and behavioral health among diverse populations, using psychometric methods and AI.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究健康公平、育儿、家庭动态和心理测量，以改善多元文化群体的心理和行为健康，使用心理测量方法和人工智能。

faculty.name: Karen D Rudolph
faculty.summary: Studies risk and protective factors for adolescent depression, using longitudinal methods and neurobiological assessments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青少年抑郁症的风险和保护因素，采用纵向研究和神经生物学评估方法。

faculty.name: Sepideh Sadaghiani
faculty.summary: Studies large-scale neurocognitive networks and functional connectivity, focusing on cognitive control and intrinsic brain activity.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大规模神经认知网络和功能性连接，重点关注认知控制和内在脑活动。

faculty.name: Lili Sahakyan
faculty.summary: Studies human long-term memory, focusing on the mechanisms and processes involved.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类长期记忆的机制和过程。

faculty.name: Fernando Sánchez Hernández
faculty.summary: Studies the cognitive mechanisms of fairness, the role of numerical cognition in social decision-making, and the attribution of agency using behavioral and neuroscientific methods with various.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究公平感的认知机制、数字认知在社会决策中的作用以及代理归因中的其他信息来源，使用行为和神经科学方法研究婴儿、儿童和成人。

faculty.name: Eleanor Seaton
faculty.summary: Studies the impact of racism on mental health outcomes among Black American youth, using mixed-methods and physiological measures.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究种族主义对黑人美国青少年心理健康结果的影响，使用混合方法和生理测量。

faculty.name: Daniel J Simons
faculty.summary: Studies visual cognition, attention, and memory, focusing on change blindness and inattentional blindness using behavioral and eye-tracking methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉认知、注意力和记忆，重点关注变化盲视和不注意盲视，使用行为和眼动追踪方法。

faculty.name: Adam Steel
faculty.summary: Studies how the human brain processes visual information, focusing on scene perception and spatial memory using behavioral studies, neuroimaging, and computational approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类大脑如何处理视觉信息，特别是场景感知和空间记忆，使用行为研究、神经成像和计算方法。

faculty.name: Chadly Daniel Stern
faculty.summary: Studies how belief systems and motivations influence perception and interaction, using experimental social psychology methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究信念系统和动机如何影响知觉和互动，使用实验社会心理学方法。

faculty.name: Brenda Straka
faculty.summary: Studies how historically marginalized groups navigate exclusion and construct social identities, using developmental cognitive foundations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究历史上被边缘化的群体如何应对排斥并构建社会身份，利用发展认知基础。

faculty.name: Caroline Tancredy
faculty.summary: Develops curricula and mentors students to integrate research, coursework, and professional growth in psychological science.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发课程并指导学生将研究、课程学习和职业发展整合到心理科学中。

faculty.name: Nathan R Todd
faculty.summary: Studies the intersection of sexual and gender minority health equity, spirituality, and religious settings, using ecological models and intersectionality.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究性少数和性别少数群体的健康公平、灵性以及宗教环境的交叉领域，使用生态模型和交叉性方法。

faculty.name: Stefan Uddenberg
faculty.summary: Studies visual working memory and social judgments, using experiments with infants and artificial face stimuli.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉工作记忆和社会判断，使用婴儿实验和人工面孔刺激。

faculty.name: Michelle Yongmei Wang
faculty.summary: Develops statistical and machine learning methods for cognitive psychology and brain sciences, using signal processing and image analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发统计和机器学习方法，应用于认知心理学和脑科学，使用信号处理和图像分析。

faculty.name: Ranxiao Frances Wang
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive control and mind wandering, human-robot interaction, and visual and spatial perception.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知控制和心智漫游、人机交互以及视觉和空间知觉。

faculty.name: Jon Anthony Willits
faculty.summary: Studies how people and machines learn and use languages and complex knowledge, using computational, neurobiological, experimental, and naturalistic methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类和机器如何学习和使用语言和复杂知识，采用计算、神经生物学、实验和自然主义方法。

faculty.name: Bo Zhang
faculty.summary: Studies personality assessment and the relationships between Big 5 traits, stress, health, and workplace outcomes using statistical methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人格评估及其与五大特质、压力、健康和职场结果之间的关系，使用统计方法。

faculty.name: Susu Zhang
faculty.summary: Develops measurement theory and psychometric tools for assessing human and machine capabilities, focusing on unstructured test responses and AI model evaluation.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发评估人类和机器能力的测量理论和心理测量工具，重点关注非结构化测试响应和AI模型评估。

faculty.name: Jont Allen
faculty.summary: Studies cochlear function and modeling, focusing on the role of DPOE in understanding from canal to cortex.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究耳蜗功能和建模，重点在于DPOE在从耳道到皮层理解中的作用。

faculty.name: Adrienne M. Antonson
faculty.summary: Studies how prenatal maternal immune activation disrupts fetal microglial function and neurodevelopment, using animal models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究母体免疫激活如何通过影响胎儿小胶质细胞的功能和神经发育，使用动物模型进行探讨。

faculty.name: Benjamin D Auerbach
faculty.summary: Studies the synaptic and circuit mechanisms of sensory processing, focusing on experience-dependent plasticity and its disruption in autism spectrum disorders and hearing disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究感觉处理的突触和电路机制，重点关注经验依赖性可塑性的生理机制及其在自闭症谱系障碍和听力障碍中的紊乱。

faculty.name: Alison M Bell
faculty.summary: Studies the evolution of paternal care in stickleback fish, linking genetic and hormonal factors to behavioral strategies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究三刺鱼父本照顾行为的进化，关联遗传和激素因素与行为策略。

faculty.name: Paul Jeffrey Bonthuis
faculty.summary: Studies how genes, epigenetic regulation, and hormone signaling in the brain interact to regulate social behaviors in mammals.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究基因、表观遗传调控和激素信号在大脑中的相互作用，调节哺乳动物的社会行为。

faculty.name: Timothy Wolfe Bretl
faculty.summary: Studies aerospace engineering and robotics, focusing on control systems and simulation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究航空航天工程和机器人技术，专注于控制系统和仿真。

faculty.name: Jonathan Cerna
faculty.summary: Investigates the neurophysiological mechanisms of cognitive, motor, and emotional benefits from practices like Tai Chi, yoga, and meditation, using multimodal approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究太极、瑜伽和冥想等身心实践的认知、运动和情绪益处的神经生理机制，采用多模态方法。

faculty.name: Jason Robert Climer
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of memory, focusing on synaptic changes and forgetting processes in the hippocampus.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究记忆的神经机制，重点关注海马体中的突触变化和遗忘过程。

faculty.name: Neal J Cohen
faculty.summary: Studies the brain's memory systems, particularly the hippocampal system, using cognitive neuropsychological, eye movement, fMRI, and ERP methods in both normal and neuropsychological populations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑的记忆系统，特别是海马系统，通过认知神经心理学、眼动、fMRI 和 ERP 方法在正常和神经心理学人群中的应用。

faculty.name: Lee DeVille
faculty.summary: Studies stochastic analysis, differential equations, and dynamical systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究随机分析、微分方程和动力系统。

faculty.name: Ryan Dilger
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of dietary supplements on animal health and immune function, focusing on cats and chickens.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究膳食补充剂对动物健康和免疫功能的影响，重点关注猫和鸡。

faculty.name: Rainer Joachim Engelken
faculty.summary: Studies neural network dynamics and information processing in recurrent neural networks, using computational methods and simulations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究递归神经网络的动力学和信息处理，使用计算方法和模拟。

faculty.name: Kara Federmeier
faculty.summary: Studies how semantic information is processed during language comprehension, using ERP techniques with younger and older adults.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语义信息在语言理解中的处理方式，使用ERP技术研究年轻和年长成年人。

faculty.name: Rebecca Fuller
faculty.summary: Studies the evolution of mating systems and sexual selection in fishes, using genomic approaches and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究鱼类交配系统和性选择的进化，采用基因组方法和行为实验。

faculty.name: Gabriele Gratton
faculty.summary: Studies brain activity using M/EEG and fMRI to understand aging and fitness effects on cognitive functions.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用 M/EEG 和 fMRI 研究衰老和体能对认知功能的影响。

faculty.name: Howard J Gritton
faculty.summary: Studies how neuromodulators affect brain rhythms and their role in learning, memory, and neuropsychiatric disorders in mice.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经调节物质如何影响大脑节律及其在学习、记忆和神经精神疾病中的作用，使用小鼠模型。

faculty.name: Joshua M Gulley
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of sex differences in vulnerability to adolescent methamphetamine exposure and the effects of combined alcohol and THC use on cognition and metabolism.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青春期甲基苯丙胺暴露的性别差异神经机制以及酒精和大麻二酚共用对认知和代谢的影响。

faculty.name: Elizabeth T Hsiao-Wecksler
faculty.summary: Develops assistive devices and studies locomotion biomechanics to improve movement control and function.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发辅助设备并研究运动生物力学，以改善运动控制和功能。

faculty.name: Fatima T Husain
faculty.summary: Studies brain connectivity and neural responses to sounds in conditions like misophonia and tinnitus using fMRI.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究声音诱发的神经反应及其与耳鸣和厌食症相关的脑连接性，使用功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)。

faculty.name: Yih-Kuen Jan
faculty.summary: Studies soft tissue biomechanics and assistive technology for musculoskeletal rehabilitation and wound healing.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究软组织生物力学及其在肌肉骨骼康复和伤口愈合中的应用。

faculty.name: Min Jee Jang
faculty.summary: Develops and uses viral vectors for gene transfer and spatial transcriptomics to study brain tropism and cell targeting.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发和使用病毒载体进行基因转移和空间转录组学研究，以研究大脑的归巢性和细胞靶向性。

faculty.name: Naiman A Khan
faculty.summary: Studies dietary behaviors and their effects on health, using randomized controlled trials and observational studies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究饮食行为及其对健康的影响，使用随机对照试验和观察研究。

faculty.name: Kyekyoon Kim
faculty.summary: Studies the growth and properties of GaN and Ga2O3 heterostructures, using advanced microscopy and device fabrication techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究GaN和Ga2O3异质结构的生长和性质，使用先进的显微镜和器件制造技术。

faculty.name: Natsumi Komatsu
faculty.summary: Studies seasonal changes in dopamine dynamics in voles using neurochemical imaging and two-photon microscopy.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究季节变化对地松鼠多巴胺动态的影响，使用神经化学成像和双光子显微镜技术。

faculty.name: Anna V Kukekova
faculty.summary: Studies the genetics and behavior of domesticated animals, focusing on foxes and dogs, using behavioral phenotypes and microbiome analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究家养动物（狐狸和狗）的行为和遗传学，使用行为表型和微生物群分析方法。

faculty.name: Fan Lam
faculty.summary: Develops computational methods for mass spectrometry imaging, focusing on brain metabolism and single-cell analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发用于质谱成像的计算方法，重点研究大脑代谢和单细胞分析。

faculty.name: Susan Ellen Leggett
faculty.summary: Studies the lived experiences and power dynamics in doctoral supervision and STEM education, using phenomenological methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究博士生监督和STEM教育中的生活体验和权力动态，使用现象学方法。

faculty.name: Daniel Llano
faculty.summary: Studies the mechanisms of complex sound processing in the auditory system, focusing on the role of cortical subnetworks and their projections to subcortical structures.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究复杂声音在听觉系统中的处理机制，重点在于皮层亚网络及其向下丘脑结构的投射作用。

faculty.name: Xiaotang Lu
faculty.summary: Develops methods for visualizing brain ultrastructure using fluorescent aptamers and expansion microscopy, contributing to understanding of brain cell diversity.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发荧光适体和膨胀显微镜等方法，用于可视化大脑超微结构，以理解脑细胞多样性。

faculty.name: Megan Mahoney
faculty.summary: Studies circadian rhythms, anxiety, and estrogen signaling in relation to toxicology and menopause, using behavioral and neural measures.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究昼夜节律、焦虑和雌激素信号传导与毒理学和更年期的关系，使用行为和神经测量方法。

faculty.name: Prashant Girdharilal Mehta
faculty.summary: Studies control systems and optimal control algorithms, using sampling and interacting particle systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究控制系统和最优控制算法，使用采样和交互粒子系统。

faculty.name: Brian Monson
faculty.summary: Studies speech recognition in noise, focusing on high-frequency cues and talker characteristics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究噪声中语音识别，重点关注高频线索和说话者特征。

faculty.name: Raksha Mudar
faculty.summary: Studies functional communication assessment in dementia, using AI tools and ERP evidence.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究痴呆症的功能性沟通评估，使用AI工具和ERP证据。

faculty.name: Gene Robinson
faculty.summary: Studies the mechanisms and evolution of social behavior in bees using genomics and systems biology, focusing on division of labor, aggression, and communication.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究蜜蜂的社会行为机制和进化，使用基因组学和系统生物学方法，重点关注分工、攻击性和交流。

faculty.name: Uwe Rudolph
faculty.summary: Studies the role of GABAA receptors in cognitive functions and microglial activation, using mouse models and pharmacological interventions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究GABAA受体在认知功能和小胶质细胞激活中的作用，使用小鼠模型和药理学干预方法。

faculty.name: Nathan E Schroeder
faculty.summary: Studies the neuronal basis of host-finding and feeding in plant-parasitic nematodes, using genetic and field experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究植物寄生线虫的宿主寻找和取食的神经基础，采用遗传和田间实验方法。

faculty.name: Mei Shen
faculty.summary: Studies neurotransmission at nanobiological structures using nanosensor probes and Scanning Electrochemical Microscopy.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用纳米传感器探针和扫描电化学显微镜研究纳米生物结构中的神经递质传递。

faculty.name: Matthew Francis Singh
faculty.summary: Studies brain dynamics and electrophysiology using precision data-driven modeling and dynamical systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脑动态和脑电生理学，使用精确的数据驱动建模和动力系统方法。

faculty.name: Pengfei Song
faculty.summary: Develops non-invasive deep-brain imaging techniques using photoacoustic tomography and ultrasound localization microscopy.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发非侵入式深脑成像技术，使用光声断层成像和超声定位显微镜。

faculty.name: Jimeng Sun
faculty.summary: Develops AI methods for healthcare, including deep learning for drug discovery and clinical trial optimization.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发人工智能方法用于医疗保健，包括深度学习在药物发现和临床试验优化中的应用。

faculty.name: Brad Sutton
faculty.summary: Studies brainstem-prefrontal-striatal pathways using fMRI to understand decision-making processes.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）研究脑干-前额叶-纹状体通路，以理解决策过程。

faculty.name: Yurii A Vlasov
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of sensory processing and behavior in rodents using electrophysiology and optogenetics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物触须皮层和次级皮层的神经机制，使用电生理学和光遗传学方法探索感觉处理和行为机制。

faculty.name: Yuan Yang
faculty.summary: Studies brain mechanisms of motor control and rehabilitation using transcranial direct current stimulation and EEG-fMRI coupling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究运动控制和康复的脑机制，使用经颅直流电刺激和EEG-fMRI耦合技术。
